headline: Fear And Greed Rises To 68 From 63
narrative: The crypto fear and greed index printed 68, up from 63, and both readings are labeled Greed, which means crowd appetite for risk strengthened inside the greed band. The index is the sentiment pipe, a single reading of how fearful or greedy crypto traders are, so a higher number means more greed and less fear. The print before 63 was 55, also labeled Greed, so the latest reading extends a climb that already moved from 55 to 63.
author: jordan
